ideas.title: Following the Money: Uncovering Medicaid Fraud in Minnesota
ideas.description: Investigate the recent indictments and investigations into Medicaid fraud in Minnesota, including the schemes and players involved.
questions: What are the most common schemes used in Medicaid fraud?
How much money has been lost to Medicaid fraud in Minnesota?
ideas.insight: This story has the potential to expose a large-scale fraud scheme and hold those responsible accountable. By following the money and investigating the schemes, we can shed light on the vulnerabilities in the system and propose solutions to prevent future fraud.
